correctness.rationale: At column j every omitted vertex has exactly \(s_{j-1}+s_j+s_{j+1}\) selected neighbors. Solving the resulting local equations exhaustively gives two disjoint classes: zero/two-words with internal gaps of length zero or two and boundary zero runs at most one; and the one-only forced word \(11(011)^m\). Gap choices yield the exact binomial sum; free selected rows on one-columns give \(4^{m+1}\). The minimum-degree layer follows algebraically from \(n=3k-2-2a+b+c\). A standalone checker independently enumerated graph subsets for \(n\le9\) and every ternary word through \(n=12\), plus identities through \(n=200\). Unbounded proof does not depend on finite checks.

value.rationale: A natural infinite-family refinement of an established two-fair domination minimum is fully classified, with all graph-subset coefficients and an exact count of optimal configurations. The nontrivial structural split into 0/2 tilings and an all-1 periodic word yields an even-support law and exponential optimum multiplicity for one residue class versus constant/linear minima in the others. This is a complete configuration enumeration for a standard supergrid family and a benchmark for higher-row enumeration, not a restatement of the known minimum.
